name: Honoring Your Body
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor their bodies by walking in the Spirit, which prevents fulfilling the lusts and sinful desires of the flesh such as adultery and uncleanness, as outlined in Galatians 5. The Word of God, described in Hebrews as piercing and discerning the deepest thoughts and intentions, reveals the need for holiness in both soul and body. Though Isaiah 53 highlights the revelation of God's power, the New Testament emphasizes living by the Spirit to overcome fleshly works, thereby honoring the body as a temple of God.
